Single focused self-correction pass (copied from 00 at 15:55:02Z, edited, finalized 16:06:52Z). Observed finding: (a) axe color-contrast came back 'incomplete' on 8 nodes because .card used a linear-gradient background so axe could not resolve the background colour; (b) the keyboard check showed no focus ring on the consignment radios (outline-style computed as 'none' under the :focus-visible rule for a small radio); (c) axe incomplete 'aria-prohibited-attr' on #release-block for aria-labelledby while the referenced visible text already sits inside it; (d) dead code in changeConsignment referenced a non-existent '#dec-announce' element and threw a TypeError on every consignment change (5 uncaught page errors in v00). Changed: moved the ambient radial gradients from body background to a fixed, z-index:-1 body::before layer so card/text backgrounds resolve to a flat colour; added .pick/.opt :focus-within surface change plus an explicit 3px ring on the focused radio; removed the redundant aria-labelledby from #release-block; removed the throwing statement and rewrote the change-consignment announcement through the live region; added syncPicker() to renderEvidence so the checked card styling follows state changes. Rechecked: full browser/axe suite re-run (27 pass / 0 fail), axe violations 0 in evidence, review and blocked-release+validation states, 0 uncaught page errors, no horizontal overflow at 320/390/1440 in all four states. ALSO: during this same pass I introduced and then fixed one regression of my own â€” clearing #release-block via textContent destroyed its child title/paragraph nodes, which broke the blocked-release state and two downstream checks; that line was removed and the checks re-run clean.

Single focused self-correction. Observed finding: after clicking a record, document.activeElement remained BODY instead of #detailTitle (diagnostic in checks/v00/focus-after-open-finding.json; raw failing run in checks/v00/run-v00-raw.log, run-checks.mjs line 131 timed out waiting for the heading to take focus). Cause: renderDetail() called h.focus() while #detailView still carried the hidden attribute, so the focus call was silently ignored. Change: moved scroll/focus out of renderDetail() into a focusDetailTitle() helper invoked from openRecord() after listView.hidden = true and detailView.hidden = false. Rechecked: full suite re-run against 01.html, 114/114 assertions pass including 'detail heading receives focus' at 320, 390 and 1440 px; no other behaviour changed.

coverage.meaning: Observed segments only. Start bases differ and some creator clocks begin after initial reading or launch work. These are not billed costs and not comparable complete-cycle savings.
coverage.initial: First preserved runnable version timestamp minus the first observed creator clock; earlier work may be excluded.
coverage.creator: Observed creator interval, including self-checks and any disclosed correction.
coverage.operator: Each entry is one browser/check segment only; it excludes harness authoring, launcher overhead, evaluator queue time and review/finalization.
unknown: exact resolved model/provider version and parameter count
input, output, thinking, cache-read and cache-write tokens
complete operator/evaluator tool and token totals
complete accepted-UI cost and any end-to-end saving
coverage.overlap: Cells ran across overlapping wall-clock windows; do not sum the intervals as total elapsed time.
coverage.budget: Protocol declares a soft 8-minute and hard 15-minute creator budget per cell; recorded overruns are reported as overruns, not trimmed.
coverage.human: Human/manual tests deferred; no screen-reader or real-device session was run.
